title: Studio: drop the `externalSharingModel` dropdown and the Ext badge once @objectstack/spec retires the key (objectstack#23268, ruling A)
body:
This card carries the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23268; the spec half (the key's retirement, its lint rules and posture-gate branch) stays on that card.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (objectstack seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18883) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`, at the maintainer's ruling. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

Ruling `6159300530` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23268, letter A (the maintainer's 「23268 同意」), item 4, verbatim:

> The objectui follow-up (the Studio dropdown and the Ext badge; 6 source files, 9 tests) is filed by seat 3 to the objectui lane (`pm:queue` + `domain:*`) now, not after the objectstack PR lands.

`externalSharingModel` (ADR-0090 D11's external OWD) has no runtime reader: no runtime principal is external, and ADR-0095/0099's `EXTERNAL` rung already defines external visibility as explicitly shared rows only, never OWD-derived. The spec retires the key on the v18 line; an author who sets it is refused with the prescription "delete the key". Studio must stop offering it, or Studio's save is refused.

## Where (read on objectui `origin/main` `b9814b3`; unverified beyond the grep)

`git grep -ln "externalSharingModel" origin/main -- 'packages/**' 'apps/**'`, excluding `CHANGELOG.md`:
- Source: `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/{ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx, PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx, StudioDesignSurface.tsx, owd-sharing.ts}`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/{PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx, i18n.ts}`.
- Tests: `ObjectSettingsPanel.{test, owdAgreement.test, sharedSelect-11865.test}.tsx`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.{layersUnsaved-11799, servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765, sharedSelect-11865}.test.tsx`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.scope.test.tsx`.

## Wanted

- Studio no longer reads, renders or writes `externalSharingModel`; the Ext badge and the "external wider than internal" comparison (`isExternalWider` in `owd-sharing.ts`) go with it.
- `publicSharing` is untouched (ruling item 3: the share-link policy).
- Tests that pin the dropdown or the badge are deleted with the feature; an absence pin is enough on one surface.

## Order

Lands when the spec pin carries the retirement (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23268's PR), or earlier if Studio dropping the field is harmless against the current pin (the field is optional; dropping it sends less). The claimant decides from the pin reading.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectui, closed included: `externalSharingModel Studio dropdown Ext badge retire` → 0 hits; control `external sharing model OWD object settings panel` → 3 hits (#5477, #11692, #2505, all closed, none this shape).
